# ============================================================
# HANDCRAFTED FEATURE FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================
def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    """30 stylometric features per text"""
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        if not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            features.append([0] * 30)
            continue
        text = str(text)
        words = text.split()
        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
        sentences = [s.strip() for s in sentences if len(s.strip()) > 0]

        char_count = len(text)
        word_count = len(words)
        sent_count = max(len(sentences), 1)
        avg_word_len = np.mean([len(w) for w in words]) if words else 0
        avg_sent_len = char_count / sent_count

        upper_ratio = sum(1 for c in text if c.isupper()) / max(char_count, 1)
        lower_ratio = sum(1 for c in text if c.islower()) / max(char_count, 1)
        digit_ratio = sum(1 for c in text if c.isdigit()) / max(char_count, 1)
        whitespace_ratio = sum(1 for c in text if c.isspace()) / max(char_count, 1)

        punct_chars = [",", ".", "!", "?", ";", ":", "-", '"', "'", "(", ")", "—"]
        punct_ratios = []
        for p in punct_chars:
            punct_ratios.append(text.count(p) / max(char_count, 1))

        unique_chars = len(set(text.lower()))
        char_diversity = unique_chars / max(char_count, 1)

        long_words = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6) / max(word_count, 1)
        capitalized_words = sum(1 for w in words if w[0].isupper() if len(w) > 0) / max(
            word_count, 1
        )
        all_caps_words = sum(1 for w in words if w.isupper() and len(w) > 1) / max(
            word_count, 1
        )

        sent_lens = [len(s.split()) for s in sentences] if sentences else [0]
        sent_len_std = np.std(sent_lens) if len(sent_lens) > 1 else 0
        sent_len_var = np.var(sent_lens) if len(sent_lens) > 1 else 0

        function_words = set(
            [
                "the",
                "a",
                "an",
                "and",
                "or",
                "but",
                "in",
                "on",
                "at",
                "to",
                "for",

                "by",
                "from",
                "as",

                "was",

                "were",
                "be",
                "been",

                "have",
                "has",
                "had",

                "does",

                "could",
                "may",
                "might",
                "shall",
                "should",
                "this",
                "that",
                "these",
                "those",
                "i",
                "you",
                "he",
                "she",
                "it",
                "we",
                "they",
                "my",
                "your",
                "his",
                "her",
                "its",
                "our",
                "their",
            ]
        )
        fw_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in function_words)
        function_word_ratio = fw_count / max(word_count, 1)

        archaic_words = set(
            [
                "hath",
                "doth",
                "thou",
                "thee",
                "thy",
                "thine",
                "ye",
                "whence",
                "thence",
                "hither",
                "thither",
                "wherefore",
                "therefor",
                "hereto",
                "hereby",
                "herein",
                "therein",
                "thereby",
                "wherein",
                "whereby",
                "perchance",
                "peradventure",
                "forsooth",
                "betwixt",
                "twixt",
                "o'er",
                "ne'er",
                "e'en",
                "oft",
                "ere",
                "anon",
                "nigh",
                "wilt",
                "shalt",
                "dost",
                "doth",
                "art",
                "wert",
                "hast",
                "hath",
            ]
        )
        archaic_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in archaic_words)
        archaic_ratio = archaic_count / max(word_count, 1)

        positive_emotion = set(
            [
                "love",
                "hope",
                "joy",
                "happy",
                "beautiful",
                "wonderful",
                "glad",
                "pleasure",
                "delight",
                "bliss",
                "ecstasy",
                "rapture",
                "enchanted",
            ]
        )
        negative_emotion = set(
            [
                "fear",
                "dread",
                "horror",
                "terror",
                "sorrow",
                "grief",
                "despair",
                "anguish",
                "misery",
                "pain",
                "agony",
                "woe",
                "gloom",

            ]
        )
        emotional_words = positive_emotion.union(negative_emotion)
        emo_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in emotional_words)
        emotional_ratio = emo_count / max(word_count, 1)

        lovecraft_words = set(
            [
                "eldritch",
                "cyclopean",
                "cryptic",
                "noisome",
                "fœtid",

                "outer",
                "cosmic",
                "blasphemous",
                "madness",
                "unnamable",
                "indescribable",
                "inscrutable",
            ]
        )
        lovecraft_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in lovecraft_words)
        lovecraft_ratio = lovecraft_count / max(word_count, 1)

        sub_conj = set(
            [
                "after",
                "although",
                "as",
                "because",
                "before",
                "even",
                "if",
                "inasmuch",

                "once",

        )
        sub_conj_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in sub_conj)
        sub_conj_ratio = sub_conj_count / max(word_count, 1)

        feat = (
            [
                char_count,

                sent_count,
                avg_word_len,
                avg_sent_len,
                upper_ratio,
                lower_ratio,
                digit_ratio,
                whitespace_ratio,
            ]
            + punct_ratios
            + [
                char_diversity,
                long_words,
                capitalized_words,
                all_caps_words,
                sent_len_std,
                sent_len_var,
                function_word_ratio,
                archaic_ratio,
                emotional_ratio,
                lovecraft_ratio,
                sub_conj_ratio,
            ]
        )
        features.append(feat[:30])
    return np.array(features, dtype=np.float32)


def create_readability_features(texts):
    """4 readability features per text"""
    features = []
    for text in texts:
        if not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            features.append([0] * 4)
            continue
        text = str(text)
        words = text.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        char_count = len(text.replace(" ", ""))

        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
        sentences = [s.strip() for s in sentences if len(s.strip()) > 0]
        sent_count = max(len(sentences), 1)

        total_syllables = 0
        for w in words:
            w = w.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if len(w) == 0:
                continue
            vowel_groups = len(re.findall(r"[aeiouy]+", w))
            if vowel_groups == 0:
                vowel_groups = 1
            total_syllables += vowel_groups

        avg_syllables = total_syllables / max(word_count, 1)
        complex_words = sum(
            1
            for w in words
            if len(re.findall(r"[aeiouy]+", w.lower().strip(string.punctuation))) > 2
        )
        complex_word_ratio = complex_words / max(word_count, 1)

        flesch = 206.835 - 1.015 * (word_count / sent_count) - 84.6 * avg_syllables
        flesch = max(0, min(100, flesch))

        ari = (
            4.71 * (char_count / max(word_count, 1))
            + 0.5 * (word_count / sent_count)
            - 21.43
        )
        ari = max(0, ari)

        features.append([flesch, ari, avg_syllables, complex_word_ratio])
    return np.array(features, dtype=np.float32)


def create_pos_tag_approximation(texts):
    """5 POS approximation features using suffix patterns"""
    noun_suffixes = [
        "tion",
        "sion",
        "ment",
        "ness",
        "ity",
        "ance",
        "ence",
        "dom",
        "ship",
        "ism",
    ]
    verb_suffixes = ["ed", "ing", "ate", "ize", "ify", "en", "ish"]
    adj_suffixes = [
        "able",
        "ible",
        "al",
        "ial",
        "ful",
        "ous",
        "ive",
        "less",
        "ic",
        "ical",
    ]
    adv_suffixes = ["ly", "ward", "wise", "ways"]

    features = []
    for text in texts:
        if not isinstance(text, str) or len(text.strip()) == 0:
            features.append([0] * 5)
            continue
        words = text.split()
        word_count = max(len(words), 1)

        noun_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if any(w.lower().endswith(s) for s in noun_suffixes)
        )
        verb_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if any(w.lower().endswith(s) for s in verb_suffixes)
        )
        adj_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if any(w.lower().endswith(s) for s in adj_suffixes)
        )
        adv_count = sum(
            1 for w in words if any(w.lower().endswith(s) for s in adv_suffixes)
        )
        content_words = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 3)

        features.append(
            [
                noun_count / word_count,
                verb_count / word_count,
                adj_count / word_count,
                adv_count / word_count,
                content_words / word_count,
            ]
        )
    return np.array(features, dtype=np.float32)


# ============================================================
# EXTRACT HANDCRAFTED FEATURES
# ============================================================
print("\nExtracting handcrafted features...")

train_stylo = extract_stylometric_features(X_train_texts)
val_stylo = extract_stylometric_features(X_val_texts)

stylo_scaler = StandardScaler()

train_read = create_readability_features(X_train_texts)

# ============================================================

char_vectorizer_short = TfidfVectorizer(

char_vectorizer_long = TfidfVectorizer(

word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(

def extract_punctuation_sequence(text):
    return "".join([c for c in text if c in string.punctuation]) if text else ""


train_punct_sequences = [extract_punctuation_sequence(str(t)) for t in X_train_texts]
val_punct_sequences = [extract_punctuation_sequence(str(t)) for t in X_val_texts]
test_punct_sequences = [extract_punctuation_sequence(str(t)) for t in test_df["text"].values]

train_sparse = hstack(

).tocsr()
val_sparse = hstack(

print(f"Sparse train shape: {train_sparse.shape}")

# ============================================================
# DEBERTA FINE-TUNING
# ============================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("FINE-TUNING DEBERTA-V3-LARGE")
print("=" * 60)

tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)
model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
    MODEL_NAME,
    num_labels=NUM_AUTHORS,
    hidden_dropout_prob=DROPOUT,
    attention_probs_dropout_prob=DROPOUT,

model.to(device)

train_encodings = tokenizer(
    list(X_train_texts),
    truncation=True,
    padding=True,
    max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
    return_tensors="pt",
)
val_encodings = tokenizer(
    list(X_val_texts),
    truncation=True,
    padding=True,
    max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
    return_tensors="pt",
)
test_encodings = tokenizer(
    list(test_df["text"].values),
    truncation=True,
    padding=True,
    max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
    return_tensors="pt",
)

train_dataset = TensorDataset(
    train_encodings["input_ids"],
    train_encodings["attention_mask"],
    torch.tensor(y_train_labels, dtype=torch.long),
)
val_dataset = TensorDataset(
    val_encodings["input_ids"],
    val_encodings["attention_mask"],
    torch.tensor(y_val_labels, dtype=torch.long),
)
test_dataset = TensorDataset(
    test_encodings["input_ids"], test_encodings["attention_mask"]
)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_dataset, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, num_workers=2, pin_memory=True
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    val_dataset,
    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE * 2,

    test_dataset,

    shuffle=False,

    pin_memory=True,

total_steps = len(train_loader) * NUM_EPOCHS
no_decay = ["bias", "LayerNorm.weight"]
optimizer_grouped_parameters = [
    {
        "params": [
            p
            for n, p in model.named_parameters()
            if not any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
        ],
        "weight_decay": WEIGHT_DECAY,
    },
    {
        "params": [
            p for n, p in model.named_parameters() if any(nd in n for nd in no_decay)
        ],
        "weight_decay": 0.0,
    },
]

    optimizer,
    num_warmup_steps=int(WARMUP_RATIO * total_steps),

class FocalLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, gamma=2.0, alpha=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.alpha = alpha

    def forward(self, logits, targets):
        ce_loss = nn.functional.cross_entropy(logits, targets, reduction='none')
        pt = torch.exp(-ce_loss)
        focal_loss = ((1 - pt) ** self.gamma) * ce_loss
        if self.alpha is not None:
            alpha_t = self.alpha[targets]
            focal_loss = alpha_t * focal_loss
        return focal_loss.mean()

def mixup_data(input_ids, attention_mask, labels, alpha=0.5):
    """Apply MixUp augmentation to a batch."""
    batch_size = input_ids.size(0)
    index = torch.randperm(batch_size, device=input_ids.device)
    lam = np.random.beta(alpha, alpha)

    mixed_input_ids = lam * input_ids.float() + (1 - lam) * input_ids[index].float()

    mixed_labels += (1 - lam) * nn.functional.one_hot(labels[index], num_classes=NUM_AUTHORS).float()

def create_readability_features(texts):
    """4 readability features per text"""
    features = []
    for text in texts:

            continue
        text = str(text)
        words = text.split()
        word_count = len(words)
        char_count = len(text.replace(" ", ""))

        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
        sentences = [s.strip() for s in sentences if len(s.strip()) > 0]
        sent_count = max(len(sentences), 1)

        total_syllables = 0
        for w in words:
            w = w.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if len(w) == 0:
                continue
            vowel_groups = len(re.findall(r"[aeiouy]+", w))
            if vowel_groups == 0:
                vowel_groups = 1
            total_syllables += vowel_groups

        avg_syllables = total_syllables / max(word_count, 1)
        complex_words = sum(
            1
            for w in words
            if len(re.findall(r"[aeiouy]+", w.lower().strip(string.punctuation))) > 2
        )
        complex_word_ratio = complex_words / max(word_count, 1)

        flesch = 206.835 - 1.015 * (word_count / sent_count) - 84.6 * avg_syllables
        flesch = max(0, min(100, flesch))

        ari = (
            4.71 * (char_count / max(word_count, 1))
            + 0.5 * (word_count / sent_count)
            - 21.43
        )
        ari = max(0, ari)

        features.append([flesch, ari, avg_syllables, complex_word_ratio])
    return np.array(features, dtype=np.float32)

        words = text.split()

        noun_count = sum(

        )
        verb_count = sum(

        adj_count = sum(

        adv_count = sum(

        features.append(

                verb_count / word_count,
                adj_count / word_count,
                adv_count / word_count,
                content_words / word_count,

        )
    return np.array(features, dtype=np.float32)

def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n


def evaluate_deberta(model, loader):
    model.eval()

            all_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            all_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())
    all_preds = np.vstack(all_preds)
    all_labels = np.concatenate(all_labels)
    logloss = compute_log_loss(all_labels, all_preds)
    acc = np.mean(np.argmax(all_preds, axis=1) == all_labels)
    return logloss, acc, all_preds

"""
Run 20260509_185008 Train+Inference Script
LogLoss: ~0.2013 (真实 log_loss, 无 INDEX_BUG)
模型: DeBERTa-v3-large fine-tuning + XGBoost + Logistic Regression + 集成

用法: python infer_0509_185008_0201.py
"""

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import re
import warnings

from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset
from torch.cuda.amp import autocast, GradScaler
from transformers import (
    AutoTokenizer,

    get_linear_schedule_with_warmup,
    get_cosine_schedule_with_warmup,
)
from torch.optim import AdamW
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, LabelEncoder
from sklearn.feature_selection import VarianceThreshold
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from scipy.sparse import hstack
import string
import xgboost as xgb

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# ============================================================
# 路径配置
# ============================================================
INFERENCE_DIR = "./input"
DATA_DIR = "./input"
TRAIN_CSV = "./input/train.csv"
TEST_CSV = "./input/test.csv"
OUTPUT_CSV = "./submission/submission.csv"
WORKING_DIR = "./working"

os.makedirs(WORKING_DIR, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================
RANDOM_STATE = 42
NUM_AUTHORS = 3
MODEL_NAME = "microsoft/deberta-v3-large"
MAX_LENGTH = 512

LEARNING_RATE = 2e-5
WEIGHT_DECAY = 0.01
NUM_EPOCHS = 40
WARMUP_RATIO = 0.1
PATIENCE = 5
DROPOUT = 0.2

np.random.seed(RANDOM_STATE)
torch.manual_seed(RANDOM_STATE)
if torch.cuda.is_available():
    torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(RANDOM_STATE)

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"Using device: {device}")

# ============================================================
# FOCAL LOSS
# ============================================================
class FocalLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, gamma=2.0, alpha=None, reduction='mean'):
        super(FocalLoss, self).__init__()
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.reduction = reduction

    def forward(self, inputs, targets):
        ce_loss = nn.functional.cross_entropy(inputs, targets, reduction='none')
        pt = torch.exp(-ce_loss)
        focal_loss = ((1 - pt) ** self.gamma) * ce_loss
        if self.alpha is not None:
            alpha_t = self.alpha[targets]
            focal_loss = alpha_t * focal_loss
        if self.reduction == 'mean':
            return focal_loss.mean()
        elif self.reduction == 'sum':
            return focal_loss.sum()
        else:
            return focal_loss

# ============================================================
# CUSTOM DEBERTA MODEL WITH ATTENTION POOLING
# ============================================================
class CustomDebertaForSequenceClassification(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, model_name, num_labels, dropout=0.3):
        super(CustomDebertaForSequenceClassification, self).__init__()
        self.num_labels = num_labels
        self.deberta = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
            model_name,
            num_labels=num_labels,
            hidden_dropout_prob=dropout,
            attention_probs_dropout_prob=dropout,
        )
        # Remove the default classifier since we build our own
        hidden_size = self.deberta.config.hidden_size
        # Attention pooling layer
        self.attention_pooling = nn.Linear(hidden_size, 1)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(hidden_size, num_labels)

    def forward(self, input_ids=None, attention_mask=None, labels=None, output_hidden_states=False):
        outputs = self.deberta.deberta(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.last_hidden_state  # [batch, seq_len, hidden]
        # Attention pooling: compute attention weights over all tokens
        attention_scores = self.attention_pooling(hidden_states).squeeze(-1)  # [batch, seq_len]
        # Mask padded tokens
        if attention_mask is not None:
            attention_scores = attention_scores.masked_fill(attention_mask == 0, -1e9)
        attention_weights = torch.softmax(attention_scores, dim=-1)  # [batch, seq_len]
        # Weighted sum of all token embeddings
        sentence_embedding = torch.bmm(attention_weights.unsqueeze(1), hidden_states).squeeze(1)  # [batch, hidden]
        sentence_embedding = self.dropout(sentence_embedding)
        logits = self.classifier(sentence_embedding)

        loss = None
        if labels is not None:
            loss_fn = FocalLoss(gamma=2.0, reduction='mean')
            loss = loss_fn(logits, labels)

        if output_hidden_states:
            return logits, sentence_embedding, outputs.hidden_states
        return logits, sentence_embedding

            count = text_str.count(punct)
            punct_ratios.append(count / n_chars if n_chars > 0 else 0)
        char_diversity = len(set(text_str)) / n_chars if n_chars > 0 else 0
        long_words_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words if len(w) >= 7) / n_words if n_words > 0 else 0
        )
        capitalized_words = sum(1 for w in words if w and w[0].isupper())
        capitalized_ratio = capitalized_words / n_words if n_words > 0 else 0
        all_caps_words = sum(1 for w in words if w.isupper())
        all_caps_ratio = all_caps_words / n_words if n_words > 0 else 0
        sent_lengths = [len(s.split()) for s in sentences]
        sent_len_std = np.std(sent_lengths) if sent_lengths else 0
        sent_len_var = np.var(sent_lengths) if sent_lengths else 0
        function_word_count = sum(1 for w in words if w in function_words)
        function_word_ratio = function_word_count / n_words if n_words > 0 else 0
        archaic_count = sum(1 for w in words if w in archaic_words)
        archaic_ratio = archaic_count / n_words if n_words > 0 else 0
        emotional_count = sum(1 for w in words if w in emotional_words)
        emotional_ratio = emotional_count / n_words if n_words > 0 else 0
        lovecraft_count = sum(1 for w in words if w in lovecraft_words)
        lovecraft_ratio = lovecraft_count / n_words if n_words > 0 else 0
        sub_conj_count = sum(1 for w in words if w in sub_conjunctions)
        sub_conj_ratio = sub_conj_count / n_words if n_words > 0 else 0
        feature_vector = [
            n_chars,
            n_words,
            n_sents,
            avg_word_len,
            avg_sent_len,
            upper_ratio,
            lower_ratio,
            digit_ratio,
            whitespace_ratio,
            *punct_ratios,
            char_diversity,
            long_words_ratio,
            capitalized_ratio,
            all_caps_ratio,
            sent_len_std,
            sent_len_var,
            function_word_ratio,
            archaic_ratio,
            emotional_ratio,
            lovecraft_ratio,
            sub_conj_ratio,
        ]
        features.append(feature_vector)
    return np.array(features)


def create_readability_features(texts):
    vowels = "aeiouy"

    def count_syllables(word):
        word = word.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
        if not word:
            return 0
        count = 0
        prev_is_vowel = False
        for char in word:
            is_vowel = char in vowels
            if is_vowel and not prev_is_vowel:
                count += 1
            prev_is_vowel = is_vowel
        if word.endswith("e"):
            count -= 1
        if count == 0:
            count = 1
        return count

    features = []
    for text in texts:
        text_str = str(text)
        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text_str)
        sentences = [s.strip() for s in sentences if s.strip()]
        words = text_str.split()
        n_words = len(words)
        n_sents = len(sentences)
        n_syllables = sum(count_syllables(w) for w in words) if words else 0
        if n_words > 0 and n_sents > 0:
            avg_syllables_per_word = n_syllables / n_words
            avg_words_per_sent = n_words / n_sents
            flesch = (
                206.835 - 1.015 * avg_words_per_sent - 84.6 * avg_syllables_per_word
            )
        else:
            flesch = 0
            avg_syllables_per_word = 0
        n_chars = sum(len(w) for w in words) if words else 0
        if n_words > 0 and n_sents > 0:
            ari = 4.71 * (n_chars / n_words) + 0.5 * (n_words / n_sents) - 21.43
        else:
            ari = 0
        complex_words = sum(1 for w in words if count_syllables(w) >= 3)
        complex_ratio = complex_words / n_words if n_words > 0 else 0
        features.append([flesch, ari, avg_syllables_per_word, complex_ratio])
    return np.array(features)

    )

        noun_count = sum(

        adj_ratio = adj_count / n_words

        content_ratio = content_count / n_words
        features.append([noun_ratio, verb_ratio, adj_ratio, adv_ratio, content_ratio])
    return np.array(features)

def stylistic_augmentation_collate_fn(batch):
    input_ids_list = []
    attention_mask_list = []
    labels_list = []
    for item in batch:
        input_ids = item[0].clone()
        attention_mask = item[1].clone()
        label = item[2]

        # Decode to text for augmentation
        text = tokenizer.decode(input_ids, skip_special_tokens=True)
        words = text.split()

        # 1. Substitute 20% of function words
        new_words = []
        for w in words:
            w_lower = w.lower().strip(string.punctuation)
            if w_lower in function_words_set and np.random.random() < 0.20:
                # Replace with another function word
                replacement = np.random.choice(list(function_words_set))
                # Preserve capitalization
                if w[0].isupper():
                    replacement = replacement.capitalize()
                new_words.append(replacement)
            else:
                new_words.append(w)
        words = new_words

        # 2. Insert archaic words with 10% chance
        new_words = []
        for w in words:
            new_words.append(w)
            if np.random.random() < 0.10:
                archaic_word = np.random.choice(archaic_words_list)
                new_words.append(archaic_word)
        words = new_words

        # 3. Perturb punctuation with 15% chance
        new_words = []
        punct_chars = set(string.punctuation)
        for w in words:
            if len(w) > 0 and w[-1] in punct_chars and np.random.random() < 0.15:
                # Swap with a random punctuation
                w = w[:-1] + np.random.choice(list(string.punctuation))
            new_words.append(w)
        words = new_words

        augmented_text = " ".join(words)
        # Re-tokenize
        encoding = tokenizer(
            augmented_text,
            truncation=True,
            padding='max_length',
            max_length=MAX_LENGTH,
            return_tensors='pt',
        )
        input_ids_list.append(encoding['input_ids'].squeeze(0))
        attention_mask_list.append(encoding['attention_mask'].squeeze(0))
        labels_list.append(label)

    return (
        torch.stack(input_ids_list),
        torch.stack(attention_mask_list),
        torch.tensor(labels_list, dtype=torch.long),
    )

def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n


def evaluate_deberta(model, loader):
    model.eval()
    all_preds = []
    all_labels = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in loader:
            input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            labels = batch[2].to(device)
            with autocast():
                logits, _ = model(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)
            all_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            all_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())
    all_preds = np.vstack(all_preds)
    all_labels = np.concatenate(all_labels)
    logloss = compute_log_loss(all_labels, all_preds)
    acc = np.mean(np.argmax(all_preds, axis=1) == all_labels)
    return logloss, acc, all_preds

    # Freeze-thaw: unfreeze encoder after epoch 3
    if epoch == 3:
        for param in model.deberta.deberta.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = True
        # Add encoder parameters to optimizer with lower learning rate
        optimizer = AdamW([
            {'params': model.deberta.deberta.parameters(), 'lr': 1e-5, 'weight_decay': 0.1},
            {'params': model.attention_pooling.parameters(), 'weight_decay': 0.1},
            {'params': model.classifier.parameters(), 'weight_decay': 0.1},
        ], lr=LEARNING_RATE, eps=1e-8)
        scheduler = get_cosine_schedule_with_warmup(
            optimizer,
            num_warmup_steps=0,
            num_training_steps=len(train_loader) * (NUM_EPOCHS - 3),
        )

    model.train()
    total_loss = 0.0
    num_batches = 0
    for batch in train_loader:
        input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
        labels = batch[2].to(device)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            logits, _ = model(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
            loss = criterion(logits, labels)
        if scaler is not None:
            scaler.scale(loss).backward()
            scaler.unscale_(optimizer)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
            scaler.step(optimizer)
            scaler.update()
        else:
            loss.backward()
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
            optimizer.step()
        scheduler.step()
        total_loss += loss.item()
        num_batches += 1
    avg_train_loss = total_loss / num_batches
    # Evaluate on original unaugmented data
    val_loss, val_acc, _ = evaluate_deberta(model, val_loader)
    print(
        f"Epoch {epoch+1:2d}/{NUM_EPOCHS} | Train Loss: {avg_train_loss:.4f} | Val Loss: {val_loss:.4f} | Val Acc: {val_acc:.4f}"
    )
    if val_loss < best_val_loss:
        best_val_loss = val_loss
        best_epoch = epoch + 1
        patience_counter = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), f"{WORKING_DIR}/best_deberta_model.pt")
    else:
        patience_counter += 1
        if patience_counter >= PATIENCE:
            print(
                f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch+1}. Best epoch: {best_epoch}, Best val loss: {best_val_loss:.4f}"
            )

        count = 0
        prev_is_vowel = False
        for char in word:
            is_vowel = char in vowels
            if is_vowel and not prev_is_vowel:
                count += 1
            prev_is_vowel = is_vowel
        if word.endswith("e"):
            count -= 1
        if count == 0:

        return count

        n_syllables = sum(count_syllables(w) for w in words) if words else 0
        if n_words > 0 and n_sents > 0:
            avg_syllables_per_word = n_syllables / n_words
            avg_words_per_sent = n_words / n_sents
            flesch = (

    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)

    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):

    return loss / n

def extract_stylometric_features(texts):
    """Extract 30 stylometric features from text."""
    features_list = []
    for text in texts:
        text = str(text)
        text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
        words = text.split()
        chars = list(text)
        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
        sentences = [s.strip() for s in sentences if s.strip()]

        if len(words) == 0:
            features_list.append([0] * 30)
            continue

        word_count = len(words)
        char_count = len(chars)
        sent_count = max(len(sentences), 1)
        avg_word_len = char_count / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0
        avg_sent_len = word_count / sent_count if sent_count > 0 else 0

        # Character ratios
        upper_ratio = (
            sum(1 for c in chars if c.isupper()) / char_count if char_count > 0 else 0
        )
        lower_ratio = (
            sum(1 for c in chars if c.islower()) / char_count if char_count > 0 else 0
        )
        digit_ratio = (
            sum(1 for c in chars if c.isdigit()) / char_count if char_count > 0 else 0
        )
        whitespace_ratio = (
            sum(1 for c in chars if c.isspace()) / char_count if char_count > 0 else 0
        )

        # Punctuation ratios
        punct_marks = [".", ",", ";", ":", "!", "?", "-", '"', "'", "(", ")", "—"]
        punct_ratios = [
            text.count(p) / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0 for p in punct_marks
        ]

        # Word-level features
        word_set = set(w.lower() for w in words)
        char_diversity = len(word_set) / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0
        long_words = (
            sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6) / word_count if word_count > 0 else 0
        )
        capitalized = (
            sum(1 for i, w in enumerate(words) if w[0].isupper() and i > 0) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )
        all_caps = (
            sum(1 for w in words if w.isupper() and len(w) > 1) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )

        # Sentence length variation
        sent_lengths = [len(s.split()) for s in sentences]
        sent_len_std = np.std(sent_lengths) if len(sent_lengths) > 0 else 0
        sent_len_var = np.var(sent_lengths) if len(sent_lengths) > 0 else 0

        # Function words
        function_words = {
            "the",
            "a",
            "an",
            "in",
            "on",
            "at",
            "to",
            "for",
            "of",
            "with",
            "and",
            "but",
            "or",
            "if",
            "because",
            "although",
            "since",
            "while",
        }
        function_word_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in function_words) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )

        # Archaic words
        archaic_words = {
            "thou",
            "thee",
            "thy",
            "thine",
            "hath",
            "doth",
            "whence",
            "thence",
        }
        archaic_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in archaic_words) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )

        # Emotional words
        emotional_words = {
            "love",
            "hate",
            "fear",
            "joy",
            "despair",
            "hope",
            "dread",
            "horror",
            "terror",
            "sorrow",
        }
        emotional_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in emotional_words) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )

        # Lovecraft-specific words
        lovecraft_words = {
            "eldritch",
            "cyclopean",
            "cosmic",
            "unspeakable",
            "antediluvian",
            "cthulhu",
        }
        lovecraft_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in lovecraft_words) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )

        # Subordinate conjunctions
        sub_conjunctions = {
            "because",
            "since",
            "after",
            "although",
            "though",
            "while",
            "until",
            "unless",
            "as",
            "if",
            "before",
            "when",
            "where",
        }
        sub_conj_ratio = (
            sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in sub_conjunctions) / word_count
            if word_count > 0
            else 0
        )

        features = [
            char_count,
            word_count,
            sent_count,
            avg_word_len,
            avg_sent_len,
            upper_ratio,
            lower_ratio,
            digit_ratio,
            whitespace_ratio,
            *punct_ratios,
            char_diversity,
            long_words,
            capitalized,
            all_caps,
            sent_len_std,
            sent_len_var,
            function_word_ratio,
            archaic_ratio,
            emotional_ratio,
            lovecraft_ratio,
            sub_conj_ratio,
        ]
        features_list.append(features)

    return np.array(features_list, dtype=np.float32)


def create_readability_features(texts):
    """Extract 4 readability features."""
    features_list = []
    for text in texts:
        text = str(text)
        words = text.split()
        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
        sentences = [s.strip() for s in sentences if s.strip()]

        if len(words) == 0 or len(sentences) == 0:
            features_list.append([0, 0, 0, 0])
            continue

        def count_syllables(word):
            word = word.lower()
            if len(word) <= 3:
                return 1
            if word.endswith("e") and len(word) > 2:
                word = word[:-1]
            vowels = "aeiou"
            count = 0
            prev_vowel = False
            for char in word:
                if char in vowels and not prev_vowel:
                    count += 1
                    prev_vowel = True
                else:
                    prev_vowel = False
            return max(1, count)

        total_syllables = sum(count_syllables(w) for w in words)
        total_chars = sum(len(w) for w in words)

        flesch = (
            206.835
            - 1.015 * (len(words) / len(sentences))
            - 84.6 * (total_syllables / len(words))
        )
        ari = (
            4.71 * (total_chars / len(words))
            + 0.5 * (len(words) / len(sentences))
            - 21.43
        )
        avg_syllables = total_syllables / len(words) if len(words) > 0 else 0
        complex_words = sum(1 for w in words if count_syllables(w) >= 3)
        complex_ratio = complex_words / len(words) if len(words) > 0 else 0

        features_list.append([flesch, ari, avg_syllables, complex_ratio])

    return np.array(features_list, dtype=np.float32)


def create_pos_tag_approximation(texts):
    """Extract 5 POS approximation features."""
    noun_suffixes = [
        "tion",
        "sion",
        "ment",
        "ness",
        "ity",
        "ance",
        "ence",
        "ship",
        "dom",
        "ism",
    ]
    verb_suffixes = ["ed", "ing", "en", "ize", "ate", "ify", "es", "s", "th"]
    adj_suffixes = ["able", "ible", "al", "ful", "ic", "ive", "ous", "less", "y", "ish"]
    adv_suffixes = ["ly", "ward", "wise"]
    function_words = {
        "the",
        "a",
        "an",
        "in",
        "on",
        "at",
        "to",
        "for",
        "of",
        "with",
        "and",
        "but",
        "or",
        "if",
        "because",
        "although",
        "since",
        "while",
    }

    features_list = []
    for text in texts:
        text = str(text)
        words = text.split()

        if len(words) == 0:
            features_list.append([0, 0, 0, 0, 0])
            continue

        total = len(words)

        def count_suffix_matches(suffixes):
            count = 0
            for word in words:
                w = word.lower()
                for suffix in suffixes:
                    if w.endswith(suffix):
                        count += 1
                        break
            return count

        noun_ratio = count_suffix_matches(noun_suffixes) / total if total > 0 else 0
        verb_ratio = count_suffix_matches(verb_suffixes) / total if total > 0 else 0
        adj_ratio = count_suffix_matches(adj_suffixes) / total if total > 0 else 0
        adv_ratio = count_suffix_matches(adv_suffixes) / total if total > 0 else 0
        function_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in function_words)
        content_ratio = 1.0 - (function_count / total) if total > 0 else 0

        features_list.append(
            [noun_ratio, verb_ratio, adj_ratio, adv_ratio, content_ratio]
        )

    return np.array(features_list, dtype=np.float32)

# Custom model: DeBERTa backbone + multi-head attention pooling + 2-layer MLP classifier
class DebertaWithAttentionPooling(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, model_name, num_labels, dropout=0.2):
        super().__init__()
        self.deberta = AutoModel.from_pretrained(model_name)
        hidden_size = self.deberta.config.hidden_size

        # Multi-head attention pooling over all token representations
        self.attention_pool = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=hidden_size, num_heads=8, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True,
        )
        self.attention_layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size)

        # 2-layer MLP classifier (intermediate dimension 512, dropout 0.2, LayerNorm)
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, 512),
            nn.LayerNorm(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(512, num_labels),
        )

        self.num_labels = num_labels
        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
        self._init_weights()

    def _init_weights(self):
        """Initialize new head layers with small random weights."""
        for module in [self.attention_pool, self.classifier]:
            for param in module.parameters():
                if param.dim() > 1:
                    nn.init.xavier_uniform_(param, gain=0.01)

    def forward(self, input_ids=None, attention_mask=None, labels=None, output_hidden_states=False):
        # Get backbone hidden states
        outputs = self.deberta(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=output_hidden_states,
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.last_hidden_state  # (batch, seq_len, hidden_size)

        # Key padding mask: True for padding tokens (to be ignored by attention)
        key_padding_mask = (attention_mask == 0) if attention_mask is not None else None

        # Masked mean pooling to get query vector for attention
        if attention_mask is not None:
            mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
            masked_hidden = hidden_states * mask
            query = masked_hidden.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True) / mask.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-9)
        else:
            query = hidden_states.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)

        # Multi-head attention pooling: query attends to all token representations
        pooled, _ = self.attention_pool(
            query=query,
            key=hidden_states,
            value=hidden_states,
            key_padding_mask=key_padding_mask,
        )
        pooled = pooled.squeeze(1)  # (batch, hidden_size)
        pooled = self.attention_layer_norm(pooled)

        # Classification through 2-layer MLP
        logits = self.classifier(pooled)

        # Compute loss if labels are provided
        loss = None
        if labels is not None:
            loss_fct = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(label_smoothing=0.1)
            loss = loss_fct(logits, labels)

        # Return a simple output object with expected attributes (loss, logits, hidden_states)
        class _ModelOutput:
            def __init__(self, loss, logits, hidden_states):
                self.loss = loss
                self.logits = logits
                self.hidden_states = hidden_states

        return _ModelOutput(
            loss=loss,
            logits=logits,
            hidden_states=outputs.hidden_states if output_hidden_states else None,
        )

def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n


def evaluate_deberta(model, loader):
    model.eval()
    all_preds = []
    all_labels = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in loader:
            input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            labels = batch[2].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = model(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
            all_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            all_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())
    all_preds = np.vstack(all_preds)
    all_labels = np.concatenate(all_labels)
    logloss = compute_log_loss(all_labels, all_preds)
    acc = np.mean(np.argmax(all_preds, axis=1) == all_labels)
    return logloss, acc, all_preds

    if "deberta" in name:

phase1_lr = 5e-4
phase1_weight_decay = 0.01
phase1_steps = len(train_loader) * phase1_epochs

# Optimizer for Phase 1 (only head parameters)
head_params = [
    p for name, p in model.named_parameters()
    if "deberta" not in name and p.requires_grad
]
optimizer_phase1 = AdamW(head_params, lr=phase1_lr, weight_decay=phase1_weight_decay, eps=1e-8)
scheduler_phase1 = get_linear_schedule_with_warmup(
    optimizer_phase1,
    num_warmup_steps=int(0.1 * phase1_steps),
    num_training_steps=phase1_steps,
)

scaler = GradScaler() if torch.cuda.is_available() else None

for epoch in range(phase1_epochs):
    model.train()
    total_loss = 0.0
    num_batches = 0
    for batch in train_loader:
        input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
        attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
        labels = batch[2].to(device)
        optimizer_phase1.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            outputs = model(
                input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask, labels=labels
            )
            loss = outputs.loss
        if scaler is not None:
            scaler.scale(loss).backward()
            scaler.unscale_(optimizer_phase1)
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
            scaler.step(optimizer_phase1)
            scaler.update()
        else:
            loss.backward()
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
            optimizer_phase1.step()
        scheduler_phase1.step()
        total_loss += loss.item()
        num_batches += 1
    avg_train_loss = total_loss / num_batches
    val_loss, val_acc, _ = evaluate_deberta(model, val_loader)
    print(

def create_readability_features(texts):
    """Extract 4 readability features."""
    features_list = []
    for text in texts:
        text = str(text)
        words = text.split()
        sentences = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text)
        sentences = [s.strip() for s in sentences if s.strip()]

        if len(words) == 0 or len(sentences) == 0:
            features_list.append([0, 0, 0, 0])
            continue

        def count_syllables(word):
            word = word.lower()
            if len(word) <= 3:
                return 1
            if word.endswith("e") and len(word) > 2:
                word = word[:-1]
            vowels = "aeiou"
            count = 0
            prev_vowel = False
            for char in word:
                if char in vowels and not prev_vowel:
                    count += 1
                    prev_vowel = True
                else:
                    prev_vowel = False
            return max(1, count)

        total_syllables = sum(count_syllables(w) for w in words)
        total_chars = sum(len(w) for w in words)

        flesch = (
            206.835
            - 1.015 * (len(words) / len(sentences))
            - 84.6 * (total_syllables / len(words))
        )
        ari = (
            4.71 * (total_chars / len(words))
            + 0.5 * (len(words) / len(sentences))
            - 21.43
        )
        avg_syllables = total_syllables / len(words) if len(words) > 0 else 0
        complex_words = sum(1 for w in words if count_syllables(w) >= 3)
        complex_ratio = complex_words / len(words) if len(words) > 0 else 0

        features_list.append([flesch, ari, avg_syllables, complex_ratio])

    return np.array(features_list, dtype=np.float32)


def create_pos_tag_approximation(texts):
    """Extract 5 POS approximation features."""
    noun_suffixes = [
        "tion",
        "sion",
        "ment",
        "ness",
        "ity",
        "ance",
        "ence",
        "ship",
        "dom",
        "ism",
    ]
    verb_suffixes = ["ed", "ing", "en", "ize", "ate", "ify", "es", "s", "th"]
    adj_suffixes = ["able", "ible", "al", "ful", "ic", "ive", "ous", "less", "y", "ish"]
    adv_suffixes = ["ly", "ward", "wise"]
    function_words = {
        "the",
        "a",
        "an",
        "in",
        "on",
        "at",
        "to",
        "for",
        "of",
        "with",
        "and",
        "but",
        "or",
        "if",
        "because",
        "although",
        "since",
        "while",
    }

    features_list = []
    for text in texts:
        text = str(text)
        words = text.split()

        if len(words) == 0:
            features_list.append([0, 0, 0, 0, 0])
            continue

        total = len(words)

        def count_suffix_matches(suffixes):
            count = 0
            for word in words:
                w = word.lower()
                for suffix in suffixes:
                    if w.endswith(suffix):
                        count += 1
                        break
            return count

        noun_ratio = count_suffix_matches(noun_suffixes) / total if total > 0 else 0
        verb_ratio = count_suffix_matches(verb_suffixes) / total if total > 0 else 0
        adj_ratio = count_suffix_matches(adj_suffixes) / total if total > 0 else 0
        adv_ratio = count_suffix_matches(adv_suffixes) / total if total > 0 else 0
        function_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in function_words)
        content_ratio = 1.0 - (function_count / total) if total > 0 else 0

        features_list.append(
            [noun_ratio, verb_ratio, adj_ratio, adv_ratio, content_ratio]
        )

    return np.array(features_list, dtype=np.float32)

def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n


def evaluate_deberta(model, loader):
    model.eval()
    all_preds = []
    all_labels = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for batch in loader:
            input_ids = batch[0].to(device)
            attention_mask = batch[1].to(device)
            labels = batch[2].to(device)
            with autocast():
                outputs = model(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
                probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
            all_preds.append(probs.cpu().numpy())
            all_labels.append(labels.cpu().numpy())
    all_preds = np.vstack(all_preds)
    all_labels = np.concatenate(all_labels)
    logloss = compute_log_loss(all_labels, all_preds)
    acc = np.mean(np.argmax(all_preds, axis=1) == all_labels)
    return logloss, acc, all_preds

nodes.code_summary: Data preprocessing included stratified train/validation split (90/10) of the training data. Feature engineering extracted 26 stylometric features (character ratios, punctuation frequencies, word-level statistics), 4 readability features (Flesch, ARI, avg syllables, complex word ratio), 5 POS approximation features, plus character n-grams (2-7), word n-grams (1-3), and punctuation n-grams via TfidfVectorizer/CountVectorizer. The DeBERTa-v3-large model was fine-tuned with a custom architecture (multi-head attention pooling + 2-layer MLP classifier) in two phases: Phase 1 froze the backbone and trained only the head; Phase 2 unfroze all layers with discriminative learning rates and cosine annealing warm restarts with early stopping. XGBoost and Logistic Regression models were trained on the combined handcrafted and DeBERTa embedding features. Final predictions were produced by a weighted ensemble of the three models with weights optimized via grid search on validation log loss.

def count_syllables_proxy(word):
    word = word.lower()
    if len(word) <= 3:
        return 1
    count = 0
    vowels = "aeiouy"
    prev_vowel = False
    for char in word:
        is_vowel = char in vowels
        if is_vowel and not prev_vowel:
            count += 1
        prev_vowel = is_vowel
    if count == 0:

    if word.endswith("e") and count > 1:

                if n_sents > 0
                else 0
            )
            long6 = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 6)
            long9 = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 9)
            features[i, 18] = long6 / n_words if n_words > 0 else 0
            features[i, 19] = long9 / n_words if n_words > 0 else 0
            all_caps = sum(1 for w in words if w.isupper() and len(w) > 1)
            capitalized = sum(1 for w in words if w[0].isupper() and len(w) > 1)
            features[i, 20] = all_caps / n_words if n_words > 0 else 0
            features[i, 21] = capitalized / n_words if n_words > 0 else 0
            unique_words = set(w.lower() for w in words)
            features[i, 22] = len(unique_words) / n_words if n_words > 0 else 0
            features[i, 23] = len(unique_words) / np.sqrt(n_words) if n_words > 0 else 0
            words_lower = set(w.lower() for w in words)
            lovecraft_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in lovecraft_words)
            poe_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in poe_words)
            shelley_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in shelley_words)
            features[i, 24] = lovecraft_count / n_words if n_words > 0 else 0
            features[i, 25] = poe_count / n_words if n_words > 0 else 0
            features[i, 26] = shelley_count / n_words if n_words > 0 else 0
            function_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in function_words)
            features[i, 27] = function_count / n_words if n_words > 0 else 0
            features[i, 28] = 1.0 - (function_count / n_words) if n_words > 0 else 0
            avg_syllables = (
                sum(count_syllables_proxy(w) for w in words) / n_words
                if n_words > 0
                else 0
            )
            features[i, 29] = (
                206.835 - 1.015 * (n_words / n_sents) - 84.6 * avg_syllables
                if n_sents > 0
                else 0
            )
    return features


def extract_structural_features(texts):
    n = len(texts)
    features = np.zeros((n, 12))
    for i, text in enumerate(texts):
        if isinstance(text, str):
            text_str = text
            words = text_str.split()
            n_words = len(words) if words else 1
            repeats = 0
            for j in range(len(text_str) - 1):
                if text_str[j] == text_str[j + 1]:
                    repeats += 1
            features[i, 0] = repeats / len(text_str) if len(text_str) > 0 else 0
            vowels = "aeiouAEIOU"
            vowel_count = sum(1 for c in text_str if c in vowels)
            features[i, 1] = vowel_count / len(text_str) if len(text_str) > 0 else 0
            consonant_count = sum(
                1 for c in text_str if c.isalpha() and c not in vowels
            )
            features[i, 2] = consonant_count / len(text_str) if len(text_str) > 0 else 0
            bigrams = [text_str[j : j + 2] for j in range(len(text_str) - 1)]
            unique_bigrams = len(set(bigrams))
            features[i, 3] = unique_bigrams / len(bigrams) if len(bigrams) > 0 else 0
            word_lens = [len(w) for w in words]
            features[i, 4] = np.percentile(word_lens, 25) if word_lens else 0
            features[i, 5] = np.percentile(word_lens, 75) if word_lens else 0
            sents = re.split(r"[.!?]+", text_str)
            sents = [s.strip() for s in sents if s.strip()]
            if sents:
                sent_word_counts = [len(s.split()) for s in sents]
                features[i, 6] = (
                    np.percentile(sent_word_counts, 25)
                    if len(sent_word_counts) > 1
                    else 0
                )
                features[i, 7] = (
                    np.percentile(sent_word_counts, 75)
                    if len(sent_word_counts) > 1
                    else 0
                )
                comma_count = text_str.count(",")
                features[i, 8] = comma_count / len(sents) if len(sents) > 0 else 0
            else:
                features[i, 6], features[i, 7], features[i, 8] = 0, 0, 0
            if word_lens:
                length_counts = Counter(word_lens)
                features[i, 9] = length_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
            else:
                features[i, 9] = 0
            stop_words = {
                "the",
                "a",
                "an",
                "and",
                "or",
                "but",
                "in",
                "on",
                "at",
                "to",
                "of",
                "for",
                "with",
                "by",
                "from",
                "is",
                "was",
                "are",
                "were",
                "been",
                "have",
                "has",
                "had",
                "not",
                "this",
                "that",
                "it",
                "its",
                "as",
                "be",
                "he",
                "she",
                "they",
                "we",
                "you",
                "i",
                "my",
                "me",
                "his",
                "her",
            }
            stop_count = sum(1 for w in words if w.lower() in stop_words)
            features[i, 10] = stop_count / n_words if n_words > 0 else 0
            punct_counts = {}
            for c in text_str:
                if c in string.punctuation:
                    punct_counts[c] = punct_counts.get(c, 0) + 1
            if punct_counts:
                total = sum(punct_counts.values())
                entropy = 0
                for count in punct_counts.values():
                    p = count / total
                    if p > 0:
                        entropy -= p * np.log2(p)
                features[i, 11] = (
                    entropy / np.log2(len(punct_counts)) if len(punct_counts) > 1 else 0
                )
            else:
                features[i, 11] = 0
    return features

def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n

class DebertaAuthorClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, model_name="microsoft/deberta-v3-large", dropout=0.2):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(model_name)
        self.config.num_labels = NUM_AUTHORS
        self.config.hidden_dropout_prob = dropout
        self.config.attention_probs_dropout_prob = dropout
        self.model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
            model_name, config=self.config, ignore_mismatched_sizes=True
        )
        hidden_size = self.config.hidden_size
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size // 2),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size // 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_size // 2, NUM_AUTHORS),
        )
        self.model.classifier = self.classifier
        self.layer_weights = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(self.config.num_hidden_layers + 1))

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, return_embeddings=False):
        outputs = self.model.deberta(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
            return_dict=True,
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states
        stacked_hidden = torch.stack(hidden_states, dim=0)
        weights = F.softmax(self.layer_weights, dim=0)
        weighted_hidden = (stacked_hidden * weights.view(-1, 1, 1, 1)).sum(dim=0)
        mask_expanded = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()
        pooled = (weighted_hidden * mask_expanded).sum(dim=1) / mask_expanded.sum(
            dim=1
        ).clamp(min=1e-9)
        logits = self.classifier(pooled)
        if return_embeddings:
            return logits, pooled
        return logits


class RobertaAuthorClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, model_name="roberta-large", dropout=0.2):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = RobertaConfig.from_pretrained(model_name)
        self.config.num_labels = NUM_AUTHORS
        self.config.hidden_dropout_prob = dropout
        self.config.attention_probs_dropout_prob = dropout
        self.model = RobertaForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
            model_name, config=self.config, ignore_mismatched_sizes=True
        )
        hidden_size = self.config.hidden_size
        self.attention_pool = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size // 2),
            nn.Tanh(),
            nn.Linear(hidden_size // 2, 1),
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size // 2),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size // 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_size // 2, NUM_AUTHORS),
        )
        self.model.classifier = self.classifier

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, return_embeddings=False):
        outputs = self.model.roberta(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
            return_dict=True,
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states[-1]
        attention_weights = self.attention_pool(hidden_states).squeeze(-1)
        attention_weights = attention_weights.masked_fill(
            ~attention_mask.bool(), float("-inf")
        )
        attention_weights = F.softmax(attention_weights, dim=-1).unsqueeze(-1)
        pooled = (hidden_states * attention_weights).sum(dim=1)
        logits = self.classifier(pooled)
        if return_embeddings:
            return logits, pooled
        return logits


class PositionalEncoding(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_model, max_len=512):
        super().__init__()
        pe = torch.zeros(max_len, d_model)
        position = torch.arange(0, max_len, dtype=torch.float).unsqueeze(1)
        div_term = torch.exp(
            torch.arange(0, d_model, 2).float() * (-math.log(10000.0) / d_model)
        )
        pe[:, 0::2] = torch.sin(position * div_term)
        pe[:, 1::2] = torch.cos(position * div_term)
        pe = pe.unsqueeze(0)
        self.register_buffer("pe", pe)

    def forward(self, x):
        return x + self.pe[:, : x.size(1), :]


class CharCNNBiLSTM(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        vocab_size=128,
        char_embed_dim=128,
        char_hidden=256,
        cnn_filters=[64, 128, 256],
        cnn_kernel_sizes=[3, 5, 7],
        lstm_hidden=256,
        num_lstm_layers=2,
        dropout=0.3,
        max_seq_length=512,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.char_embedding = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, char_embed_dim, padding_idx=0)
        self.char_dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList()
        conv_output_dim = 0
        for num_filters, kernel_size in zip(cnn_filters, cnn_kernel_sizes):
            conv = nn.Conv1d(
                in_channels=char_embed_dim,
                out_channels=num_filters,
                kernel_size=kernel_size,
                padding=kernel_size // 2,
            )
            self.convs.append(conv)
            conv_output_dim += num_filters
        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(
            input_size=conv_output_dim,
            hidden_size=lstm_hidden,
            num_layers=num_lstm_layers,
            batch_first=True,
            bidirectional=True,
            dropout=dropout if num_lstm_layers > 1 else 0,
        )
        self.lstm_dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=lstm_hidden * 2, num_heads=8, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )
        self.attention_norm = nn.LayerNorm(lstm_hidden * 2)
        self.pos_encoder = PositionalEncoding(lstm_hidden * 2, max_seq_length)
        classifier_input = lstm_hidden * 2
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(classifier_input, classifier_input // 2),
            nn.LayerNorm(classifier_input // 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(classifier_input // 2, classifier_input // 4),
            nn.LayerNorm(classifier_input // 4),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(classifier_input // 4, NUM_AUTHORS),
        )

    def forward(self, char_ids, char_mask=None, return_embeddings=False):
        char_emb = self.char_embedding(char_ids)
        char_emb = self.char_dropout(char_emb)
        char_emb = char_emb.transpose(1, 2)
        conv_outputs = []
        for conv in self.convs:
            conv_out = conv(char_emb)
            conv_out = F.gelu(conv_out)
            conv_out = F.adaptive_max_pool1d(conv_out, output_size=1).squeeze(-1)
            conv_outputs.append(conv_out)
        cnn_features = torch.cat(conv_outputs, dim=-1)
        cnn_features_seq = cnn_features.unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, char_ids.size(1), -1)
        cnn_features_seq = self.pos_encoder(cnn_features_seq)
        lstm_out, _ = self.lstm(cnn_features_seq)
        lstm_out = self.lstm_dropout(lstm_out)
        attn_out, _ = self.attention(lstm_out, lstm_out, lstm_out)
        attn_out = self.attention_norm(lstm_out + attn_out)
        if char_mask is not None:
            mask_expanded = char_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()
            pooled = (attn_out * mask_expanded).sum(dim=1) / mask_expanded.sum(
                dim=1
            ).clamp(min=1e-9)
        else:
            pooled = attn_out.mean(dim=1)
        logits = self.classifier(pooled)
        if return_embeddings:
            return logits, pooled
        return logits

# LOSS FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================
class LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1, reduction="mean"):
        super().__init__()
        self.smoothing = smoothing
        self.reduction = reduction

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        n_classes = pred.size(1)
        with torch.no_grad():
            smoothed_targets = torch.full_like(pred, self.smoothing / (n_classes - 1))
            smoothed_targets.scatter_(1, target.unsqueeze(1), 1.0 - self.smoothing)
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(pred, dim=-1)
        loss = -(smoothed_targets * log_probs).sum(dim=-1)
        if self.reduction == "mean":
            return loss.mean()
        elif self.reduction == "sum":
            return loss.sum()
        return loss


class FocalLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, alpha=None, gamma=2.0, reduction="mean"):
        super().__init__()
        self.alpha = alpha
        self.gamma = gamma
        self.reduction = reduction

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        ce_loss = F.cross_entropy(pred, target, reduction="none")
        pt = torch.exp(-ce_loss)
        focal_loss = (1 - pt) ** self.gamma * ce_loss
        if self.alpha is not None:
            alpha_t = self.alpha.gather(0, target)
            focal_loss = alpha_t * focal_loss
        if self.reduction == "mean":
            return focal_loss.mean()
        elif self.reduction == "sum":
            return focal_loss.sum()
        return focal_loss


class CombinedLoss(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, smoothing=0.1, gamma=1.5, ce_weight=0.7, focal_weight=0.3):
        super().__init__()
        self.ce_loss = LabelSmoothingCrossEntropy(smoothing=smoothing)
        self.focal_loss = FocalLoss(gamma=gamma)
        self.ce_weight = ce_weight
        self.focal_weight = focal_weight

    def forward(self, pred, target):
        loss1 = self.ce_loss(pred, target)
        loss2 = self.focal_loss(pred, target)
        return self.ce_weight * loss1 + self.focal_weight * loss2

class FGM:
    def __init__(self, model, epsilon=0.5):
        self.model = model
        self.epsilon = epsilon
        self.backup = {}

    def attack(self):
        for name, param in self.model.named_parameters():
            if param.requires_grad and "embedding" in name:
                self.backup[name] = param.data.clone()
                norm = torch.norm(param.grad)
                if norm != 0 and not torch.isnan(norm):
                    r_at = self.epsilon * param.grad / norm
                    param.data.add_(r_at)

    def restore(self):
        for name, param in self.model.named_parameters():
            if name in self.backup:
                param.data = self.backup[name]
        self.backup = {}

def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred_proba):
    eps = 1e-15
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    row_sums = y_pred_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    y_pred_proba = y_pred_proba / row_sums
    y_pred_proba = np.clip(y_pred_proba, eps, 1 - eps)
    n = y_true.shape[0]
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(NUM_AUTHORS):
            if y_true[i] == j:
                loss -= np.log(y_pred_proba[i, j])
    return loss / n

class DebertaAuthorClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, model_name="microsoft/deberta-v3-large", dropout=0.2):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(model_name)
        self.config.num_labels = NUM_AUTHORS
        self.config.hidden_dropout_prob = dropout
        self.config.attention_probs_dropout_prob = dropout
        self.model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
            model_name, config=self.config, ignore_mismatched_sizes=True
        )
        hidden_size = self.config.hidden_size
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size // 2),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size // 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_size // 2, NUM_AUTHORS),
        )
        self.model.classifier = self.classifier
        self.layer_weights = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(self.config.num_hidden_layers + 1))

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, return_embeddings=False):
        outputs = self.model.deberta(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
            return_dict=True,
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states
        stacked_hidden = torch.stack(hidden_states, dim=0)
        weights = F.softmax(self.layer_weights, dim=0)
        weighted_hidden = (stacked_hidden * weights.view(-1, 1, 1, 1)).sum(dim=0)
        mask_expanded = attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()
        pooled = (weighted_hidden * mask_expanded).sum(dim=1) / mask_expanded.sum(
            dim=1
        ).clamp(min=1e-9)
        logits = self.classifier(pooled)
        if return_embeddings:
            return logits, pooled
        return logits


class RobertaAuthorClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, model_name="roberta-large", dropout=0.2):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = RobertaConfig.from_pretrained(model_name)
        self.config.num_labels = NUM_AUTHORS
        self.config.hidden_dropout_prob = dropout
        self.config.attention_probs_dropout_prob = dropout
        self.model = RobertaForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
            model_name, config=self.config, ignore_mismatched_sizes=True
        )
        hidden_size = self.config.hidden_size
        self.attention_pool = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size // 2),
            nn.Tanh(),
            nn.Linear(hidden_size // 2, 1),
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size // 2),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size // 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_size // 2, NUM_AUTHORS),
        )
        self.model.classifier = self.classifier

    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask, return_embeddings=False):
        outputs = self.model.roberta(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            output_hidden_states=True,
            return_dict=True,
        )
        hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states[-1]
        attention_weights = self.attention_pool(hidden_states).squeeze(-1)
        attention_weights = attention_weights.masked_fill(
            ~attention_mask.bool(), float("-inf")
        )
        attention_weights = F.softmax(attention_weights, dim=-1).unsqueeze(-1)
        pooled = (hidden_states * attention_weights).sum(dim=1)
        logits = self.classifier(pooled)
        if return_embeddings:
            return logits, pooled
        return logits


class PositionalEncoding(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_model, max_len=512):
        super().__init__()
        pe = torch.zeros(max_len, d_model)
        position = torch.arange(0, max_len, dtype=torch.float).unsqueeze(1)
        div_term = torch.exp(
            torch.arange(0, d_model, 2).float() * (-math.log(10000.0) / d_model)
        )
        pe[:, 0::2] = torch.sin(position * div_term)
        pe[:, 1::2] = torch.cos(position * div_term)
        pe = pe.unsqueeze(0)
        self.register_buffer("pe", pe)

    def forward(self, x):
        return x + self.pe[:, : x.size(1), :]


class CharCNNBiLSTM(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        vocab_size=128,
        char_embed_dim=128,
        char_hidden=256,
        cnn_filters=[64, 128, 256],
        cnn_kernel_sizes=[3, 5, 7],
        lstm_hidden=256,
        num_lstm_layers=2,
        dropout=0.3,
        max_seq_length=512,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.char_embedding = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, char_embed_dim, padding_idx=0)
        self.char_dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.convs = nn.ModuleList()
        conv_output_dim = 0
        for num_filters, kernel_size in zip(cnn_filters, cnn_kernel_sizes):
            conv = nn.Conv1d(
                in_channels=char_embed_dim,
                out_channels=num_filters,
                kernel_size=kernel_size,
                padding=kernel_size // 2,
            )
            self.convs.append(conv)
            conv_output_dim += num_filters
        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(
            input_size=conv_output_dim,
            hidden_size=lstm_hidden,
            num_layers=num_lstm_layers,
            batch_first=True,
            bidirectional=True,
            dropout=dropout if num_lstm_layers > 1 else 0,
        )
        self.lstm_dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=lstm_hidden * 2, num_heads=8, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )
        self.attention_norm = nn.LayerNorm(lstm_hidden * 2)
        self.pos_encoder = PositionalEncoding(lstm_hidden * 2, max_seq_length)
        classifier_input = lstm_hidden * 2
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(classifier_input, classifier_input // 2),
            nn.LayerNorm(classifier_input // 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(classifier_input // 2, classifier_input // 4),
            nn.LayerNorm(classifier_input // 4),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(classifier_input // 4, NUM_AUTHORS),
        )

    def forward(self, char_ids, char_mask=None, return_embeddings=False):
        char_emb = self.char_embedding(char_ids)
        char_emb = self.char_dropout(char_emb)
        char_emb = char_emb.transpose(1, 2)
        conv_outputs = []
        for conv in self.convs:
            conv_out = conv(char_emb)
            conv_out = F.gelu(conv_out)
            conv_out = F.adaptive_max_pool1d(conv_out, output_size=1).squeeze(-1)
            conv_outputs.append(conv_out)
        cnn_features = torch.cat(conv_outputs, dim=-1)
        cnn_features_seq = cnn_features.unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, char_ids.size(1), -1)
        cnn_features_seq = self.pos_encoder(cnn_features_seq)
        lstm_out, _ = self.lstm(cnn_features_seq)
        lstm_out = self.lstm_dropout(lstm_out)
        attn_out, _ = self.attention(lstm_out, lstm_out, lstm_out)
        attn_out = self.attention_norm(lstm_out + attn_out)
        if char_mask is not None:
            mask_expanded = char_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()
            pooled = (attn_out * mask_expanded).sum(dim=1) / mask_expanded.sum(
                dim=1
            ).clamp(min=1e-9)
        else:
            pooled = attn_out.mean(dim=1)
        logits = self.classifier(pooled)
        if return_embeddings:
            return logits, pooled
        return logits
